በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
ወቦ: ቦ — and there is (ወ- + existential ቦ 'there is')
ማእምረ: ማእምር — knower of (agent noun, construct of ማእምር, from አእመረ 'know')
ልብ: ልብ — heart (noun; here the genitive in ሐዘነ ልብ 'sorrow of heart')
ለአዳም: አዳም — of/for Adam · Adam as object, marked with ለ- (ሤሞ ለአዳም 'he appointed Adam') · ለ- naming the owner after an anticipating suffix (ስሕተቱ ለአዳም 'Adam's error') and in apposition (ላዕሌሁ ለአዳም 'upon him, upon Adam')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 'let them say, let them call' (3mp jussive, ሎሙሰ ይብሉ አማልክቲሆሙ 'as for them, let them call them their gods')
ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
ወእንስሳ: እንስሳ — and livestock, animals (ወ- + collective noun, accusative)
ወአራዊት: አርዌ — and wild beasts (ወ- + plural አራዊት)
ወዓሣተ: ዓሣ — and fish (ወ- + plural ዓሣት, accusative/construct 'fish of')
ወአዕዋፈ: ዖፍ — and birds (ወ- + plural አዕዋፍ, accusative)
ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
ተሀቦ: ወሀበ — that you give him (2ms subjunctive after ከመ, w-h-b, + -ኦ '3ms him')
ዝናመ: ዝናም — rain (noun, accusative) · construct 'rain of' (ዝናመ እሳት 'rain of fire')
ወወርኀ: ወርኅ — and moon (ወ- + noun, accusative; also 'month')
ወሀቦ: ወሀበ — he gave him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object) · with the -ኦ anticipating a ለ- phrase (ወሀቦ ለወልዱ 'he gave him, to his son') · give him! (ወ- + 2ms imperative ሀብ + -ኦ '3ms him', ወሀቦ ወለተከ 'give him your daughter')
በሌሊት: ሌሊት — by night (በ- 'in' + noun, fem.; adverbial)
ወሰዐሞ: ሰዐመ — and he kissed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him'; the part kissed is a second accusative)
ላዕሌሁ: ላዕለ — upon, over (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form ላዕሌ-) · 'against' (ወቀንኡ ላዕሌሁ 'and they envied him', lit. 'against him', ch. 95) (?)
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ወሤሞ: ሤመ — and he appointed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, ś-y-m + -ኦ '3ms him')
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
ወአዘዞ: አዘዘ — and he commanded him (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him')
ኢይብላዕ: በልዐ — that he not eat; here 'break, void' (a figure) (ኢ- + 3ms subjunctive, G, b-l-ʿ) (?)
እምአሐቲ: አሐዱ — from one (እም- + numeral, fem. አሐቲ)
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — he transgressed, overstepped (3ms perfect, tä-ʿädäwä) · it surpassed (ወእምሰሎሞንኒ ተዐደወ ጥበብኪ 'your wisdom surpassed even Solomon')
ወበልዐ: በልዐ — and it ate, devoured (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-l-ʿ)
ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
ወምኑነ: ምኑን — and rejected, despised (ወ- + passive participle, accusative)
እምይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — from now on, indeed (እም- + ይእዜ 'now' + enclitic -ሰ)
ወአውሥኦሙ: አውሥአ — and he answered them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative-type stem + -ሙ '3mp them')
ሐመይዎ: ሐመየ — they slandered him (3mp perfect + -ዎ '3ms him'; root inferred from ሐሜት) (?)
ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
ሥጋ: ሥጋ — flesh, body (noun; construct 'flesh of') · 'meat' as food (ከመ ይብልዓ ሥጋ 'to eat meat'; ነሥአ ሥጋ 'took meat') · his body, with -ሁ (ሥጋሁ)
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
ወአውሥኡ: አውሥአ — and they answered (ወ- + causative 3mp perf., w-ś-ʾ)
ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
አነሂ: አነ — I also, I too (1s independent pronoun + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible · Adam, in ዘመደ አዳም 'the kin of Adam' (the human race; ch. 53) · (?) as predicate in ኢኮነ አዳም 'it is not comely' (of ላሕይ 'appearance'), read like the earlier predicate use, 'pleasing, comely' (?); 'ruddy' (cf. አደመ 'be red') is the alternative (?)
እመሬት: መሬት — from the ground, dirt (እም- + noun)
እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
ለግብረ: ግብር — for the work of (ለ- 'for' + noun, construct state 'work-of')
እደዊየ: እድ — my hands (noun, plural እደው, stem እደዊ- + -የ '1cs my')
ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
ዘተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — who transgressed, departed (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of ዐደወ) · who surpassed (ዘተዐደወ እምጥበበ ሰብእ 'who surpassed the wisdom of men')
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return') · in case, perhaps (እመ ይሁበከ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'perhaps God may give you offspring') · mother (እም, accusative, predicate: ወኮነተኪ እመ 'and she became a mother to you')
በልዐ: በልዐ — he/it ate (3ms perfect, G, b-l-ʿ; the verb may stay singular before a plural subject such as አባግዕ 'sheep')
ወትቤሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of defective ይቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him')
ሞተ: ሞተ — he died (3ms perfect, G, m-w-t); ድኅረ ሞተ ሴም 'after Shem died' · noun 'death' in the figura etymologica ከመ ሞተ ኢትሙቱ 'that you not die the death' (?) · death (ሞት, noun, accusative; ነሣእነ ሞተ ወሕይወተ 'we have taken death and life')
ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ዘይበልዕ: በልዐ — which he eats (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
ጥዑመ: ጥዑም — sweet (adjective, accusative, before መባልዕተ) · predicate accusative after ኮነ (ይኩን ጥዑመ 'let it be sweet'; ማይ መሪር ይከውን ጥዑመ 'bitter water becomes sweet')
እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel') · 'above' in ተሰብሐ እምነ ኵሎሙ 'was praised above (?) all of them', or possibly the agent 'by' (?)
ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
ንቤ: ብህለ — we said (1cp perfect ንቤ of the defective ይቤ, ትቤ, ንቤ; b-h-l)
አውሥኦሙ: አውሥአ — he answered them (3ms perfect + -ሙ '3mp them', causative of ወሥአ, w-ś-ʾ) · or 'answer them' (2ms imperative; same spelling)
መሓሪ: መሓሪ — merciful (active participle, agent noun of ምሕረ, m-ḥ-r)
ህየንተ: ህየንተ — in place of, instead of (preposition, + genitive)
፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53) · 'anyone' after a negative or ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ያእምር ፩ 'without anyone knowing')
ዚአክሙ: ዚአ — your (possessive pronoun ዚአ + -ክሙ '2mp your'; 'in the command of yours')
ዘሥጋ: ሥጋ — of flesh (ዘ- + noun; 'the law of the flesh')
ወቦቱ: በ — and with it (ወ- + preposition በ- with 3ms suffix ቦቱ) · 'and with him (were)', i.e. 'he had' (possession, ወቦቱ ክብረ ወብዕለ 'and he had glory and riches')
፭: ፭ — 5, spoken ኀምስቱ (ḫaməstu) 'five'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'five' (፭ ስሑታን 'five erring ones'; spoken ኀምስቱ before a masculine) · spoken ኀምስ (ḫaməs) before a feminine noun (፭ ዓመተ 'five years')
ወለእመ: እመ — and if (ወ- + ለእመ, conditional conjunction)
አጥብዐ: አጥብዐ — he strengthened, steadied (3ms perfect, ʾa-stem, ṭ-b-ʿ; the base verb is not established) (?)
የሐውር: ሖረ — he walks, goes (3ms imperfect, ḥ-w-r)
በኅሊና: ኅሊና — by the thought, design of (በ- + noun, construct) · 'in thought' (ወጠቢብ በኅሊና 'and wise in thought')
ሠናይ: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adj.) · 'good' as a substantive (ዘይረክበከ ሠናይ 'what good will find you')
ወለእመሰ: እመ — and if indeed, but if (ወ- + ለእመ + enclitic -ሰ contrastive)
ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him') · 'with him, in his hand' expressing possession or disposal (እስመ ኀቤሁ ክብር ወኀሳር 'for with him are glory and loss')
በፍኖት: ፍኖት — on the road, in the way (በ- + noun, fem.)
ወአንትሙሰ: አንትሙ — and you (pl.), for your part (ወ- + 2mp pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ባዕደ: ባዕድ — other, foreign (adjective, accusative masc. sg., agreeing with አማልክተ)
ዕቡይ: ዕቡይ — proud, arrogant (adj.) · the proud one, used as a noun (ዕቡይ ወጽኑዕ 'the proud and strong one'; ዕቡይ as predicate 'Satan the proud one')
ዘአሥረጻ: አሥረጸ — who made it sprout (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, causative of ሠረጸ, + -a 'it')
ለእከይ: እከይ — evil (ለ- restating the object of አብዝኃ) · ወርእሳ ለእከይ 'its head, of evil': ለ- introduces the owner of the noun after the anticipating suffix -ሃ, እከይ 'evil' (noun, genitive sense), not the object of አብዝኀ
ወተስዕረ: ተሰዕረ — and he was defeated, cast out (?) (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ሰዐረ) (?)
ወአንትሙኒ: አንትሙ — and you too (ወ- + 2mp pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
ኮንክሙ: ኮነ — you became (2mp perfect, G, k-w-n, ending -ክሙ)
እምኔሁ: እም — from (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form እምኔ-) · 'than it', in comparison (ልብሰ ዘይኄይስ እምኔሁ 'a garment better than it')
ወ: ወ — and (conjunction, written as a separate word before ይቤሉ) · also a separate word before በደኃሪ ባሕር ('and in the last sea') · also a separate word before አንሥኦ ('and he raised', ወ ፡ አንሥኦ ለትሑት)
ትእዛዝየ: ትእዛዝ — commandment (noun, singular, possibly collective; from አዘዘ; + -የ 'my', 1cs)
ለነ: ለ — to us, for us (ለ- + 1cp suffix -ነ) · 'over us' (ንገሢ ለነ 'reign over us')
መንፈሳዊያን: መንፈሳዊ — spiritual ones (adjective, plural -ያን, used as noun)
መሬታዊ: መሬታዊ — earthly, of the earth (adjective; formed on መሬት 'earth, soil', a word I could not check in Dillmann; here 'earthly one(s)') (?)
ንክል: ክህለ — we can, are able (1cp imperfect, G, k-h-l)
ጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — certain, exact; 'certainly' (adjective, accusative/adverbial form in -a)
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
